# statusdrift_tag (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_tag" "critical" {
  name  = "critical"
  color = "#FF0000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the tag (max 255 characters).

### Optional

- `color` (String) The hex color of the tag (e.g. #FF5733). Must match the pattern #[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the tag.
